push.title: Notifications on this device

descriptions.on: You'll get alerts for nearby matches, offers, messages and meetups, even when the app is closed.
descriptions.off: Turn them on to know right away when someone near you has a card you're looking for.
descriptions.denied: Notifications are blocked for this site in your browser settings.
descriptions.unsupported: This browser doesn't support push notifications.
descriptions.iosNeedsInstall: On iPhone they only arrive if you add CardExchange to your Home Screen.
descriptions.iosTooOld: On this iPhone notifications need iOS 16.4 or later.

push.toggleError: Couldn't update notifications, please try again.
push.testSent: Test notification sent: it should arrive in a few seconds.

guide.bannerTitle: Get alerts on your iPhone too
guide.bannerText: On iPhone, notifications only arrive if you add CardExchange to your Home Screen. It takes 30 seconds.
guide.title: Turn on notifications
guide.intro: So you know right away when someone nearby has a card you want, messages you or confirms a meetup.
guide.inApp: You're using another app's built-in browser (e.g. Instagram): from here you can't add CardExchange to your Home Screen. Copy the link and open it in Safari.
guide.otherBrowser: We recommend Safari: copy the link and open it there. Since iOS 16.4 the Share menu in Chrome and Edge works too.
guide.tooOld: Your iPhone runs iOS {{version}}: web notifications need iOS 16.4 or later. Update from Settings → General → Software Update.

safari.title: Open CardExchange in Safari
safari.text: Use the address you're looking at now.

share.title: Tap Share
share.text: It's the square with an upward arrow, in the bottom bar (at the top on iPad).

add.title: Choose "Add to Home Screen"
add.text: If you don't see it, scroll the menu down. Then tap "Add".

open.title: Open CardExchange from the icon
open.text: From the Home Screen, not from Safari. Go to Profile, turn on "Notifications on this device" and tap "Allow".

androidSteps: Go to Profile and turn on "Notifications on this device".
Optional: from Chrome's ⋮ menu choose "Install app" to get a Home Screen icon.

blockedSteps.iphone: iPhone: Settings → Notifications → CardExchange → Allow Notifications.
blockedSteps.android: Android (Chrome): tap the icon left of the address → Permissions → Notifications → Allow.
blockedSteps.desktop: Computer: click the icon left of the address and allow notifications for this site.

guide.done: Done? Try "Send a test notification" in your Profile.
